newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm with crude, more offers seen.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm with crude, more offers seen.

text.p: NWE naphtha was firmer on Wednesday as crude futures staged another rally, traders said.
Dealers said they expected the award on Thursday of a tendered Alexandria cargo, loading in around 10 days' time, and of a Ras Lanuf cargo, loading around the same time.
A trader was heard offering Greek product while another trader still held an unsold Skikda cargo, for which he was still asking around high cif +$4.
An ARA end user was heard having bought a number of small off-spec Russian pieces this week, at a discount to quoted numbers. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
